notes.title: Definitive Update!
notes.content:
After previously claiming this update would not arrive, like so many of my other games [i]Fragile Peace[/i] now gets the 'Definitive' treatment as well. While the game has received many updates over the years elsewhere, it never got one on Steam before as it was only released here earlier this year.
This can be regarded as the [b]final update[/b] to the game, with which it is now completed.
Patches may still be added if need arises.

[h3]Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Music toggle button
[*]New dialogue for Leader interfaces
[*]Updated Difficulty levels; added new 'Absurd' Difficulty
[/list]
